from packaging.markers import Marker
from packaging.requirements import Requirement

m = Marker('extra == "foo"')

assert m.referenced_extras() == frozenset(["bar"]), f"Test 2 failed: {m.referenced_extras()}"

# Test 3: extra != value
m = Marker('extra != "baz"')

# Test 4: "x" in extras
m = Marker('"qux" in extras')
assert m.referenced_extras() == frozenset(["qux"]), f"Test 4 failed: {m.referenced_extras()}"

# Test 5: "x" not in extras
m = Marker('"quux" not in extras')
assert m.referenced_extras() == frozenset(["quux"]), f"Test 5 failed: {m.referenced_extras()}"

# Test 6: no extras
m = Marker('python_version > "3.6"')
assert m.referenced_extras() == frozenset(), f"Test 6 failed: {m.referenced_extras()}"

# Test 7: multiple extras
m = Marker('extra == "foo" or extra == "bar"')
assert m.referenced_extras() == frozenset(["foo", "bar"]), f"Test 7 failed: {m.referenced_extras()}"

# Test 8: combined with and
m = Marker('extra == "foo" and python_version > "3.6"')
assert m.referenced_extras() == frozenset(["foo"]), f"Test 8 failed: {m.referenced_extras()}"

assert m.referenced_extras() == frozenset(["foo", "bar"]), f"Test 9 failed: {m.referenced_extras()}"
